verdict.summary: Creating a public connection and authorizing your own account needs no Notion review and takes minutes. Access is controlled by the capabilities you pick and the pages each user shares, not by OAuth scope strings. Only a Marketplace listing goes through Notion's security review, and that step is where timing is uncertain.
verdict.hands_on_effort: 1-2 hours for your own connection and token checks; add a few hours for Marketplace listing assets and submission (estimate, not from findings)
verdict.time_to_first_connection: Under 30 minutes (estimate from the steps; not measured)
verdict.approval_wait: None to connect your own account or use 'Selected workspaces only'. Marketplace listing: Notion replies within 5-10 business days of submission; security review timeline not found.

gates.name: Own account (public connection, not listed)
gates.unlocks: Create the public connection in the developer portal and run the full authorize and token flow with your own Notion account.
limits: Redirect URI must meet Notion's format rules (protocol included; no fragments, relative paths, wildcards, or public IP).
Installation scope is fixed at creation; changing it means creating a new connection.

gates.name: Selected workspaces only (not Marketplace-eligible)
gates.unlocks: Other members of workspaces you select can authorize the connection. Notion's docs say a public connection can be created and used without a Marketplace listing.
limits: Each user must complete the authorization flow individually; one member's authorization does not cover others.
Selected-workspace connections cannot be listed on the Marketplace.
No install cap or unreviewed-app restriction found in official pages read (inferred; not confirmed by a source).
Community-reported rate limit of about 3 requests/second per integration, shared across all workspaces using the app (not confirmed by official page).
gates.time_to_reach: Same session as Gate 1, once the installation scope is set to 'Selected workspaces only' at creation

gates.name: Marketplace listing (Any workspace + security review)
gates.unlocks: Listing the public connection in the Notion Marketplace, so anyone can find and install it.
limits: Only public connections with 'Any workspace' scope are eligible.
Listing requires a Notion security review before it appears.
Rejections can cite brand or trademark issues, quality concerns, or failing baseline criteria; resubmission is allowed.
Listing best-practice document was linked but not read.
gates.time_to_reach: Build the connection with 'Any workspace' scope, draft the listing, submit, then wait for Notion's reply (5-10 business days for the reply; security review duration not found).

steps.title: Confirm the account and workspace you will use
steps.detail: Sign in to Notion with the account you will authorize with, and pick a development workspace. The docs state a workspace owner role is required for internal connections; they do not state it for public connections, so use an owner account to be safe.
gotchas: Owner requirement for public connections is not confirmed.

steps.title: Open the Notion developer portal
steps.detail: Go to https://app.notion.com/developers/connections. The legacy my-integrations URL on notion.so redirects here, and the page did not show a login wall in testing.

steps.title: Create the public connection
steps.detail: In the sidebar, open Build > Public connections, then click Create new connection. Fill in the name, development workspace, redirect URI(s), installation scope, and capabilities.

values.label: Menu path
values.value: Build > Public connections > Create new connection

steps.title: Choose the installation scope carefully
steps.detail: Pick 'Any workspace' only if you plan a Marketplace listing. Pick 'Selected workspaces only' to limit installs before review. This choice cannot be changed later; switching requires a new connection.

values.label: Installation scope options
values.value: Any workspace (Marketplace-eligible) or Selected workspaces only (not Marketplace-eligible)

gotchas: Choosing 'Selected workspaces only' rules out a Marketplace listing for this connection.

steps.title: Enter the redirect URI
steps.detail: Paste the exact callback URL from your Composio auth config into the redirect URI field. Notion requires a protocol and rejects fragments, relative paths, wildcards, and public IP addresses.

values.label: Redirect URI
values.value: Composio callback URL (see the Composio callout on this page)

gotchas: Composio's default callback path differs from the one used in testing. Confirm which path to register before you save.
The Notion docs do not state a limit on the number of redirect URIs.

steps.title: Select capabilities
steps.detail: Choose the capabilities the app needs, such as read content, update content, or insert content. These appear in the authorization prompt that users see before the page picker. Grant only what the app uses.

values.label: Capabilities
values.value: Read content, Update content, Insert content, as needed

steps.title: Copy the client ID and client secret
steps.detail: Open the Configuration tab of the new connection and copy the client ID and client secret. Store the secret in your Composio custom auth config or your secrets manager, never in client-side code.

steps.title: Run a test authorization with your account
steps.detail: Build the authorize URL with client_id, redirect_uri, response_type=code, owner=user, and an optional state. Open it in a browser, select pages in the page picker, and complete the flow. The Authorization URL field in the console stays empty until the connection is submitted for review, so build it by hand.
gotchas: The page picker only lists pages you have full access to.
Pages are shared with the connection only if you finish the flow after selecting them.

steps.title: Exchange the code for a token and check the response
steps.detail: POST to the token endpoint with HTTP Basic auth built from client ID and secret, and a JSON body with grant_type=authorization_code, the code, and the same redirect_uri. Record whether the response includes refresh_token.
gotchas: Sources conflict on whether a refresh token is returned. Check the live response before you design token storage.

steps.title: Test the refresh flow
steps.detail: Call the token endpoint with grant_type=refresh_token. Check that you get a new access token and a new refresh token, and store the new refresh token each time. If no refresh token comes back, plan for re-authorization.

steps.title: Connect through Composio
steps.detail: Use Composio's managed Notion OAuth app for quick testing. For your own app, enter the client ID and secret in a custom auth config and confirm the callback URL matches the Redirect URI you registered. Composio's default scopes list is empty, so no scope list is needed.

values.label: Redirect URI
values.value: Composio callback URL (see the Composio callout on this page)

gotchas: Confirm which Composio callback path to register; the default path and the path used in testing differ.

steps.title: Authorize other workspace members individually
steps.detail: Each member who will use the connection must complete the authorization flow on their own. Plan the rollout as one authorization per user, not per workspace.

steps.title: Plan for the shared rate limit
steps.detail: Throttle requests to about 3 per second per integration and back off on HTTP 429. Note the community-reported secondary limit of 1,000 requests per 5 minutes per workspace. Both figures need confirmation against Notion's official rate-limit page.
gotchas: The budget is shared across all workspaces using the same app.

steps.title: Create a Marketplace listing (optional)
steps.detail: Create a new connection with 'Any workspace' scope, since existing 'Selected workspaces only' connections cannot be listed. Then go to Listings > Connections and enter the name, description, category, tags, listing images, logo, and the public connection. Read the Connection Gallery Best Practices document before you submit.
gotchas: Required assets and policy pages are not fully listed in the findings; check the best-practice document.

steps.title: Submit for review and wait
steps.detail: Save and submit the listing for review by the Notion team. Expect an email within 5-10 business days. If rejected, fix the cited issue and resubmit.
gotchas: Security review applies before listing. Its duration was not found.

steps.title: Wait for the Notion decision
steps.detail: Notion's team reviews the listing and security requirements. Treat the 5-10 business day figure as the reply window, not a guaranteed decision date.

requirements.detail: Must include a protocol; no URL fragments, relative paths, wildcards, or public IP address. Paste the exact Composio callback URL.

requirements.item: Workspace owner role (documented for internal connections only)
requirements.detail: Docs say owner role is required to create an internal connection. Not stated for public connections; use an owner account to be safe.
One member's authorization does not cover other members of the workspace.
'Selected workspaces only' is not Marketplace-eligible and cannot be changed later.
Only public connections with 'Any workspace' scope can be listed.

requirements.item: Notion security review before Marketplace listing
requirements.detail: Public connections must pass a Notion security review before being listed. Public connections can be used without a listing.
Name, description, category, tags, listing images, logo, and the associated public connection, submitted under Listings > Connections.

scopes.effect: Access is set by the capabilities you pick plus the pages each user shares. There is no scope list to request or justify.

scopes.scope: Capabilities: read content, update content, insert content, etc.
scopes.effect: Chosen at connection setup and shown in the authorization prompt before the page picker. Request only what the app needs. Notion did not publish a review tier for capabilities in the findings.

blockers.symptom: Connection created as 'Selected workspaces only' but you later want a Marketplace listing
blockers.cause: Installation scope is fixed at creation and not Marketplace-eligible when set to Selected workspaces only.
blockers.fix: Create a new public connection with 'Any workspace' scope and list that one. The existing connection cannot be changed.

blockers.symptom: Token response has no refresh_token, or the access token appears not to expire
blockers.cause: Sources conflict. Notion's official docs describe refresh tokens; a Nango guide says no refresh token is returned and the access token never expires.
blockers.fix: Check a live token response before designing storage. If no refresh_token comes back, plan for re-authorization.

blockers.cause: Community reports about 3 requests/second per integration, shared across all workspaces using the app, plus a secondary limit of 1,000 requests per 5 minutes per workspace. Not confirmed against the official page.
blockers.fix: Throttle and back off on 429. Confirm the limits on Notion's official rate-limit page before relying on them.

blockers.symptom: Redirect fails or callback mismatch after saving the connection
blockers.cause: Redirect URI is declared on the connection and must match. Composio's default callback path differs from the path used in testing, and Notion's format rules reject fragments, relative paths, wildcards, and public IPs.
blockers.fix: Paste the exact Composio callback URL from your auth config into the Redirect URI field. Confirm the callback path with Composio before saving.

blockers.cause: Rejections can cite brand or trademark issues, quality concerns, or failing baseline criteria.
blockers.fix: Read the rejection email, fix the cited issue, and resubmit. Review the Connection Gallery Best Practices document before submitting.

composio.note: Composio's managed Notion OAuth app is the fast path for testing (authorization URL https://api.notion.com/v1/oauth/authorize, token URL https://api.notion.com/v1/oauth/token, no default scopes). Build your own public connection when you need your own branding, your own consent flow, or a Marketplace listing. Confirm which Composio callback URL to register in the Notion connection before you save.
